items.title: Mojo is now fully open source
items.oneliner: Mojo hit 1.0 and Apache 2.0. Qualcomm now has a serious bid for AI-native systems tooling.

items.title: Cerebras unveiled its CS-4 system
items.oneliner: Cerebras claims 30x faster inference with CS-4, pushing wafer-scale hardware from curiosity toward real datacenter procurement.

items.title: Alibaba pushed Qwen onto its own chip
items.oneliner: Alibaba says its 5nm RISC-V chip runs Qwen-3.8 27B natively, hinting at a post-GPU edge stack.

items.title: OpenAI paused frontier RL training
items.oneliner: OpenAI paused frontier RL for two weeks, a rare admission that capability gains are outrunning security and alignment controls.

items.title: Python exposed an IDNA security footgun
items.oneliner: Python's str.lower() can break IDNA comparisons, which means a basic string helper just became security review material.

items.title: GitHub suffered a broad platform outage
items.oneliner: GitHub ran degraded for 7 hours 47 minutes, with web errors near 20% and downloads failing at 50%.

items.title: Google bought airline data for training
items.oneliner: Google paid $10 million for Spirit Airlines data, showing proprietary enterprise exhaust is now contested model fuel.

items.title: Apple rewrote EU app economics
items.oneliner: Apple replaced its Core Technology Fee in the EU, giving developers more payment flexibility under real regulatory pressure.

items.title: Memory prices are spiking hard
items.oneliner: DDR5 prices are reportedly up 500% in a year, turning RAM into a first-order constraint for local AI builds.

items.title: NVIDIA opened TensorRT Model Connect
items.oneliner: NVIDIA's public preview skips intermediate export steps, which could remove a painful deployment seam for inference teams.
